title: Ultimate Thanksgiving Challenge
description:
S02 E04 — $25,000 Thanksgiving
Giada De Laurentiis challenges the three final chefs to make a dish that represents the person they're most thankful for, and they each have to incorporate a different type of squash.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E01 — Tis the Season Open House
Autumn-inspired food, including chai chocolate truffles, white velvet soup, spicy cocktail puffs and jam cocktails.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E02 — Classic Thanksgiving
Holiday dishes with a modern spin, including pumpkin Alfredo lasagna rolls, crispy truffled turkey and caramelized apple semifreddo cake.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E03 — Friendsgiving Party
A cocktail-style Thanksgiving celebration with appetizer-sized versions of beloved holiday dishes, like stuffing arancini, turkey Waldorf bites, charred Brussels sprout crostini and a mulled cosmo cocktail.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E04 — Santa's Grab Bag
Roasted fennel with Parmesan; creamy lobster pasta; chocolate almond cheesecake; citrus berry vermouth spritz.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E05 — Holiday Desserts
Indulgent desserts and sparkling cocktails, including orange mousse with ginger snap crumble, peppermint patty sandwich cookies, hazelnut torte with chocolate espresso frosting and lemon hazelnut spritz cocktails.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E06 — Kids' Gingerbread House Party
Giada treats her daughter Jade and friends to a party, where each guest makes their own gingerbread house; kid-friendly treats like s'mores popcorn, pizza grilled cheese, veggie forest with Parmesan ranch dip and frozen hot chocolate affogatos.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S01 E07 — Christmas at Giada's
Giada hosts a Christmas dinner for family and friends; on the menu, tortellini in Parmesan brodo, risotto with clams, braised lamb shanks with escarole and radicchio and a chocolate candy cane tower.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E01 — Halloween Open House
Giada hosts a Halloween open house for neighborhood trick-or-treaters and their parents; Giada creates a spooky menu for her guests which includes Coconut Bones, Spooky Chicken Finger Sammies, Witches' Brooms and Here's Looking at Boo Treats.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E02 — Happy Hour
Giada De Laurentiis hosts a fancy, vintage-inspired cocktail party and serves throwback recipes with a modern twist like bacon onion dip, a spiked gelatin mold and a Korean shrimp cocktail.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E03 — Thanksgiving Feast
Giada De Laurentiis asks her Thanksgiving guests to each bring something to add to a large antipasti platter; spicy turkey breast cacciatore; smoky candied carrots and walnut gremolata; simple wilted greens; chocolate chunk hazelnut pie.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E04 — Thanksgiving Brunch
The morning after Thanksgiving, Giada De Laurentiis feeds her guests with a brunch made from Thanksgiving leftovers; crispy turkey bites; cheesy root vegetable bake; sweet potato puffs; rye-spiked chai lattes.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E05 — Christmas Sing Along
Giada De Laurentiis throws a pre-Christmas party for the kids; holiday sing-along; cheesy chicken flautas; veggie voodle salad; chocolate-covered chips; apple pie soda à la mode.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S02 E06 — Christmas Dinner at Giada's
Giada De Laurentiis' family members exchange Secret Santa gifts; stuffed tricolore pork loin; roasted acorn squash agrodolce; chopped romaine and radicchio salad; black and white brownie ice cream cake.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E01 — Chicken and Pie Party
Savory butternut squash crostata; lemony fried chicken; tiramisu icebox torta; Lambrusco sangria; the table is filled with a variety of fall pies for guests to sample and enjoy as they celebrate the start of the holiday season.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E02 — Giada's Turkey Day Feast
Giada has a step-by-step approach for planning and executing Thanksgiving; lemon and pea Alfredo; sweet and savory kale salad; prosciutto-wrapped turkey; for dessert, mascarpone cannoli cheesecake.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E03 — That's A Wrap! Party
It's the day after Thanksgiving, and that usually means three things: college football, Christmas shopping and Thanksgiving leftovers; Giada marks the official start of the Christmas season with wrapping gifts and delicious food.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E04 — Christmas Cocktails
A Christmas cocktail party and silly Santa gift exchange; holiday appetizers and favorite karaoke tunes; spinach artichoke panini bites; warm citrus marinated olives; chocolate coconut cake and burnt citrus cocktails.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E05 — Santa's Cookies
Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter Jade host a Christmas party for Jade and her friends; Giada prepares a batch of holiday cutout sugar cookies that the kids can decorate using a variety of fun toppings and frosting.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S03 E06 — The Night Before Christmas Party
In Italy, the night before Christmas is celebrated with the Feast of the Seven Fishes, and Giada De Laurentiis hosts a family Christmas Eve dinner that honors this tradition.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E01 — Holiday Kick-Off Brunch
Giada De Laurentiis kicks off the season with a buffet brunch that features the flavors of autumn; bacon cranberry scones with citrus basil butter; sweet potato; kale Spanish frittata; smoked salmon waffles with waffle bar; apple raspberry sangrias.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E02 — Giada's Italian Thanksgiving
Giada De Laurentiis is ready to host this year's family Thanksgiving dinner; polenta popovers with lemon butter; baked turkey Parmesan; sweet and salty mashed potatoes; chocolate pumpkin cheesecake souffle.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E03 — Small Bites Pot-Luck Party
Giada De Laurentiis hosts an open house and makes a variety of Italian-themed appetizers; goat cheese-stuffed baby peppers; crispy chicken meatballs; shrimp fra diavolo bites; chocolate Christmas tree brownies; a whiskey spritz cocktail.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E04 — Name That Holiday Tune Party
Giada hosts a party where guests are asked to come dressed as their favorite holiday song; guests enjoy Giada's festive menu that includes a mozzarella bar, chicken piccata skewers, slow-roasted mustard salmon and a Sparkling Cosmo Punch.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E05 — Winter Wonderland Party
Giada hosts a holiday party for kids and transforms the house into a winter wonderland; guests get to make their own snow globes and enjoy a menu of creamy tomato soup, triple chocolate hot cocoa, crispy chicken sandwiches and Italian flag cookies.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S04 E06 — Family Christmas Dinner
Giada hosts family Christmas dinner and pulls out all the stops with a fun gift exchange and an elegant menu; she makes a simple standing rib roast, Blistered Baby Pepper Salad, cavatelli with Gorgonzola and tomatoes and a panettone trifle.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E01 — Giada's Fall Festival
Giada hosts a harvest-themed festival for her neighbors; the feast includes roasted squash and Gorgonzola pizza, made with Giada's own pizza dough, complemented with Italian carrot salad and spiced apple cake.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E02 — Family and Friends Thanksgiving
Giada asks each family member to invite a friend and provides a personalized welcome message, the guests enjoy a menu of braised turkey braciole, bacon stuffing with radicchio and chestnuts, Brussels sprouts agrodolce and Parmesan Apple Pie.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E04 — Thankful For You
Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter, Jade, host a holiday party for friends; Jade helps prepare the menu, prep for the party and plan the activity of making homemade Christmas gifts for a teacher; the menu is a gourmet twist on kid favorites.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E03 — Giada's Holiday Challenge
Giada De Laurentiis invites her cousins to bring an appetizer over for a Christmas party, and surprise guest Aunt Raffy judges which is the best; after the highly competitive game, Giada and her guests dine on a festive buffet-style meal.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E05 — Giada and Raffy's Christmas Miracle
Giada is on a mission to recreate a family holiday recipe called miracle rice with her Aunt Raffy; the dish reflects generations of stories and memories; they also create a simple sorbet before ending the night with a grab-bag gift exchange.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E06 — Italian Christmas Brunch
Giada hosts a formal brunch for her family on Christmas day, with a California twist; her menu includes beef tenderloin with scallion salsa verde, a crab and artichoke frittata, olive biscuits and a decadent chocolate panettone sformato for dessert.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E07 — Live Well Party
Giada helps her girlfriends jump-start the new year with a fun gathering that focuses on wellness and self-care; she serves a buffet menu of her healthy wedge salad, broiled salmon with fennel salad, and herb de Provence roasted potatoes.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E01 — Christmas Family Fun
Bakers craft two different decorated Christmas tree cookies; in the display challenge, bakers must create a giant cookie puzzle based on a Christmas carol.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E02 — Traditions Turned Trendy
Cookie makers hack classic cookie cutter shapes and decorate them with totally wild new designs; bakers build an entire Christmas tree out of cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E03 — Santa's Sweet Spot
For the display round and with $10,000 on the line, the remaining cookie makers must bring a winter wonderland scene to life using cookies to create a 3D tableau.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E04 — Cookie Pairings
Cookie mug toppers and decadent cookie dunkers; in the display round, the final three prepare an entirely edible cookie platter, complete with edible shot glasses.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E05 — Christmas Gifts
Making decorated cookie toys in the first round; in the display round, cookie masters make entirely edible cookie boxes to fill with Christmas cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E06 — Spice Up Your Christmas
Putting wintry Christmas window views on a cookie; in the display round, the remaining cookie masters represent their favorite Christmas Eve tradition in 3D cookie form.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E07 — Crafty Christmas
Five bakers take on a stringy trend and build Christmas cookie carousels.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E01 — Christmas Vacation
Five cookie makers enter the workshop to find host Eddie Jackson lounging in a beach chair under a palm tree; the bakers are challenged to create cookies perfect for a Christmas in the tropics.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E02 — Christmas Surprises
Eddie Jackson mistakenly grabs his box of Halloween cookie cutters from the attic; five cookie makers must hack the Halloween cutters into classic Christmas cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E03 — Some Assembly Required Christmas
Five of America's best cookie makers create two cookies on sticks: one representing the best part of Christmas for kids and another showing the best part for grown-ups; judges Ree Drummond, Dan Langan and Aarti Sequeira weigh in.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E04 — Modern Classics
For the decorating challenge, five of the cleverest cookie makers design two different cookies: one showcasing Santa's new outfit and another featuring his new ride; Vivian Chan, Ree Drummond and Gesine Prado judge.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E05 — Christmas Comes in All Sizes
Five of America's finest cookie makers must use traditional nesting dolls as inspiration to make six cookies of the same design that get progressively smaller; Stephanie Boswell, Ree Drummond and Molly Yeh judge.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E06 — Mr. and Mrs. Claus
Everyone knows how Santa Claus spends Christmas Eve, but for this decorating challenge, host Eddie Jackson asks five talented cookie makers to imagine what Christmas Eve looks like for Mrs. Claus.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E07 — Colorful Christmas
Festive foodies have been lighting up social media with hip ombre hues; for the decorating challenge, host Eddie Jackson asks five trendy cookie makers to create cookies that feature at least four shades of a color.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E01 — Homemade Holidays
Eddie Jackson cherishes homemade gifts that come from the heart, so he asks five of the top cookie makers to create cookies that look like handcrafted gifts; the bakers have to create complex cookie garlands.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E02 — Center of the Season
Five talented cookie makers strive for the spotlight when Eddie Jackson presents the most difficult decorating challenge of all: the dreaded slice-and-bake.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E03 — Merry Christmas Makeover
The competitors decorate cookies showing beloved characters from the North Pole getting fit while judges Matt Adlard, Ree Drummond and Brandi Milloy decide which cookie makers shape up and which ones ship out.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E04 — Colors of Christmas
Five creative cookie makers are dreaming of a white Christmas as Eddie Jackson challenges them to decorate cookies using only detail, texture and relief.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E05 — Picture-Perfect Christmas
Eddie Jackson invites five of America's finest cookie makers to take on the world of fine art by assembling spectacular cookie mosaics; the cookie masters have to arrange decorated cookies into a single image worthy of display in the Louvre Museum.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E06 — Christmas Traditions
Five of the finest cookie makers around push the envelope when Eddie Jackson calls on them to craft creative Christmas cards out of cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E07 — Christmas Mischief
There's no hiding when Eddie Jackson tasks five of America's best cookie makers with creating Christmas character masks made of cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S03 E08 — Bright Lights, Big Cookies
Eddie Jackson challenges five talented cookie makers to flex their skills with classic cookie cutters, using them to make dazzling designs that have nothing to do with the cutters' original shapes.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E01 — Can You Crack This One?
Celebrating "piece" on Earth by making festive puzzle cookies; bakers are tasked with creating a 3D nutcracker doll out of cookies and incorporate walnuts, pecans or almonds into the product.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E02 — Visions of Christmas
The five bakers use cookies to show off their vision of Christmas future; building baked and breakable gift displays to re-create the joy of unwrapping gifts on Christmas morning.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E03 — Homespun Christmas
Five talented cookie makers are tasked with creating Christmas cross-stitch cookies; the crafting continues as the bakers combine the beauty of a wreath with the fun of a Christmas character in one massive, 3-D cookie display.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E04 — Christmas Illusions
Five cookie makers make Christmas colors swirl by taking on the tie-dye cookie trend; they decorate cookies that look just like savory holiday appetizers, but they must use classic crudités ingredients in their cookie displays.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E05 — Christmas Games and Music
Five cookie makers begin with mix-and-match Christmas character cookies; then the bakers must craft 3D cookie displays inspired by holiday music where they must incorporate ingredients from classic Christmas songs, like pears, figs and chestnuts.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S04 E06 — Christmas Is Heating Up
Five cookie makers put their heart and soul into crafting cookies that celebrate Christmas weddings; the competition heats up as the cookie makers create 3D Christmas trees inspired by plants found deep in the dessert.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E01 — Returning Champs
Five former champions return to the workshop for another round of competition; creating a Christmas village puzzle out of six perfectly interlocking cookies and crafting massive Christmas mantels with realistic fireplaces.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E02 — Self-Portraits
Five cookie-makers re-create the feel of a cup of hot cocoa on a frosty Christmas morning by crafting holiday mugs out of cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E03 — Christmas Cookie Games
Five bakers flip the script on classic Christmas designs; the bakers make edible board games; incorporating boozy flavors into cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E04 — A Very Retro Christmas
Five top cookie makers create Christmas cookies that reflect decades past; crafting edible snow globes with 360-degree shine while drawing flavor inspiration from globe-shaped ingredients like blood oranges, golden berries and grapes.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E05 — Christmas Chandeliers
Five cookie makers must take on the latest dessert trend and create cookies decorated to reveal surprises beneath the icing, then they have to defy gravity by building giant, hanging, cookie chandeliers worthy of the finest Christmas dinner table.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E06 — Present for Santa Claus
Five festive cookie makers use their imaginations to decorate cookies that feature the perfect present for ol' Saint Nick; the bakers also fashion the ultimate Christmas party-starter: life-size ugly Christmas sweaters.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E07 — Tsunami Cookies
Five merry cookie makers put their sweet spin on Christmas wreaths, then, in a Christmas pull-me-up display challenge, the bakers release a tsunami of icing that completely transforms their towering displays.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E08 — Reindeer Auditions
Santa's recruiting new animals for his team, and it's up to five cookie makers to come up with the candidates; after hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson select which reindeer replacements make the squad, the bakers craft one-of-a-kind 3D snowmen.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E01 — Christmas Couples
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson invite four cookie-making couples to make two gift tags -- one for each of them; the pairs then construct a fortress fit to withstand a snowball fight with a ready pile of snowballs in hopes of winning $10,000.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E02 — Gingerbread Parties and Downtown North Pole
Five cookie makers must come up with gingerbread men costumes and are challenged to construct candy filled versions of Downtown North Pole.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E03 — Crafty Christmas
Five cookie makers take on a new DIY Christmas decor trend, string art; they construct spinning Christmas cookie carousels for $10,000.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E04 — Christmas Roots
Five crafty cookie makers design their own interpretation of a young Santa and Mrs. Claus; cookie greenhouses with edible windows and herbs.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E05 — Our Better Angels
Five cookie makers reveal who's on Santa's list by creating cookies showing someone doing a good deed and another being naughty; competitors create a display of cookie angel figurines filled with good spirits.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E06 — Christmas Then and Now
Ree and Eddie challenge five cookie makers to make holiday cookies from when dinosaurs roamed the Earth; the bakers craft 3D vehicles fueled with soda flavors for moving around the North Pole.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E07 — Wacky Christmas
Five merry cookie makers must create edible Christmas comic strips; the bakers create larger-than-life cookie ornaments that must incorporate some extra-small ingredients.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E08 — Christmas Behind the Scenes
Five fantastic cookie makers reveal what happens the day after Christmas at the North Pole; the competitors help Santa park his sleigh with decorated and durable cookie rooftops.

title: Gingerbread Giants: Path to Victory
description: Five skilled amateur gingerbread artists take edible architecture to new heights as they go head-to-head at the 25th annual National Gingerbread House Competition in Asheville, N.C.

title: Gingerbread Giants 2
description: Taking cookie architecture to the next level, five gingerbread artists from across the country go head-to-head at the 26th annual National Gingerbread House Competition at The Omni Grove Park Inn in Asheville, N.C.

title: Buddy vs. Duff Holiday
description:
S01 E01 — Holiday: Cartoon Christmas
Buddy and Duff face off with Christmas cakes inspired by Charlie Brown.

title: Buddy vs. Duff Holiday
description:
S01 E02 — Santa's Workshop
Cakes portraying Santa's workshop.

title: Buddy vs. Duff Holiday
description:
S01 E03 — The Nutcracker
Buddy and Duff create cakes capturing scenes from "The Nutcracker."

title: Buddy vs. Duff Holiday
description:
S01 E04 — Winter Wonderland
Buddy and Duff create winter wonderlands for the final battle.

title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
description:
S01 E01 — Season's Meetings
At the Scout Elves' Enchanted Cottage, Duff Goldman asks the teams to create an edible shelf for their own Scout Elf; the bottom teams must impress judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt with their memory-filled snow globe showpieces.

title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
description:
S01 E02 — Celebrating the Season
The bakers help their Scout Elves take the perfect elfie selfies with edible backdrops for their photos; the bottom two teams design an edible holiday outfit for judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt's elf fashion show.

title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
description:
S01 E03 — 12 Days of Elf-mas
The Scout Elves want to play the "12 Days of Christmas" at their concert, but they mix up the lyrics; Duff Goldman tasks the teams with delivering a twisted-up "12 Days of Elfmas" showpiece.

title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
description:
S01 E04 — The Reason for the Season
The scout elves have some trouble tuning up Santa's sleigh, so Duff Goldman asks the teams to create a sleigh design that will wow Mr. Claus; two teams build inventive snow forts for a snowball fight between judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt.

title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
description:
S01 E05 — It's Not Goodbye Forever
The scout elves fly over their favorite places as they return to the North Pole, so Duff Goldman challenges the finalists to elf-ify a famous landmark; Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt award their Ambassadors of Confectionery Concoctions with $25,000.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E01 — Tricked Out Turkey
A giant edible skating rink with fondant figurines for a surprise party; a non-profit organization requests a unique way to get kids excited about seasonal fruits and veggies for an upcoming cooking class.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E03 — Main Street Winter Wonderland
A company commissions a five-foot replica of their local town Main Street decked out as a winter wonderland for their Christmas party; touring Reptile Company wants their company mascot, an Asian water monitor lizard, made for their holiday party.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E06 — The Nutcracker Sweet
Brenda and Alisha create a larger-than-life-sized Nutcracker for a local dance academy's performance of the eponymous ballet; a non-profit organization commissions a turn-of-the-century house in Haiti for their annual fundraiser auction.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E08 — Slam-Dunking Santa
The Osmond family asks Brenda and Alisha to build a replica of their 150-year-old log cabin for a fundraiser to benefit the National Multiple Sclerosis Society; Alisha's relatives surprise their son with a basketball-themed Santa Claus cookie.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E09 — A Christmas Carol Creation
Hale Centre Theatre in Salt Lake City is launching its 34th season of "A Christmas Carol," and Brenda and Alisha are asked to create their grandest build yet; a build to thank a local firehouse.

title: Holiday Cookie Builds
description:
S01 E10 — Countdown to Cookie
Brenda and Alisha use a drone to help them design a shortbread replica of the City County Clock Tower and its Romanesque architecture; a replica of an English cottage-style home as the centerpiece for a holiday brunch.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E01 — Naughty or Nice
Bakers vie to create the definitive gingerbread showpiece; they receive a competition curveball mid-challenge that requires them to switch gears from assembling gingerbread to creating holiday treats to act as functional parts of their final pieces.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E03 — Santa's Most Incredible Workshop
Three bakers race to create their take on a gingerbread North Pole; the judges hand out some praise and some cold critiques while trying to decide whose gingerbread piece is good enough to give its creator a trip to the grand finale.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E04 — Ultimate Holiday Celebration
Three finalists create their biggest Ultimate Holiday Celebration scene; the competitor that wows the judges the most will win the grand prize and be featured in Food Network Magazine as the first Holiday Gingerbread Showdown Champion.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E01 — Canine Christmas
Paige Davis unleashes the three bakers on a challenge to make gingerbread showpieces that tell quite a tail; they also create holiday treats delicious enough to prove the bite is as big as their bark.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E02 — Worst Christmas Ever
The three bakers use their sense of humor to make their best gingerbread creations while envisioning the worst Christmas ever.

title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E03 — Santa's Day Off
A cookier, a caker and a gingerbread book maker use their baking skills to give the big man a much-needed day off; classic gingerbread techniques, showstopping icing artwork and tropical decorations on full display.

title: Macy's Thanksgiving Cake Spectacular
description: Martha Stewart welcomes four cake artists as they craft cake tributes to Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade balloons and floats; cake masters Buddy Valastro and Yolanda Gampp decide which masterpieces deserve the $25,000 prize.

title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
description:
Thanksgiving Special
Michael Symon shares Thanksgiving recipes, beginning with a flavorful mezcal and maple roasted turkey in cheesecloth; he also makes pap's ham and dumplings, and strawberry cheesecake with pretzel crust.

title: Thanksgiving Grubdown
description: Carla Hall discovers some Thanksgiving traditions with a twist, including pumpkin pancakes piled high with a slice of cheesecake, a complete dinner reimagined as a giant sandwich, and a 23-pound cake made with layers of holiday pies.

title: Turkey Day Sunny's Way
description: Sunny Anderson is named the first guest editor of Food Network Magazine; Sunny invites friends who are featured in the magazine to share favorite holiday recipes; Sunny makes grilled turkey with lemon pepper glaze and crowdsourced stuffing.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E01 — Winter Wonderland
Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers to create fantasy snow globe cakes that capture the magic and joy of the holidays; each team uses ice sculpture to enhance the glitz and glam of their display and impress the judges.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E02 — Mrs. Claus' Night Off
Casey Webb challenges three teams of master holiday bakers and their ice sculptors to show off a new side of Santa's better half in out-of-this-world cake designs and displays.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E03 — Countdown to Christmas
Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers and their ice sculptors to create colossal Christmas tree cake displays complete with edible presents, ornaments and pyrotechnics.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E04 — Santa's Christmas Eve
The three remaining baking teams and their ice sculptors must create the ultimate "Night Before Christmas" cake display featuring Santa.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E01 — Holiday Cookie Madness
Eight bakers have to prove their cookie baking skills in the first two challenges. The first challenge requires the bakers to use an assigned baking tool and the second challenge has the bakers using different holiday ingredients.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E02 — Classic Holiday Flavors
The seven remaining bakers take classic flavors to a new level; a swirled treat using eggnog; different versions of sugar and spice for a special dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — It's Not the Holidays Without Pie
The six remaining bakers take on making pies; the first challenge has the bakers using a store-bought crust; the second challenge involves three different pies and three different crusts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Holiday Cake-Over
The five bakers left to compete take the fruitcake to a new level and reinvent the yule log.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E05 — Great Holiday Traditions
The four bakers must use the classic holiday flavors of peppermint and hot chocolate in a dessert and then create a holiday breakfast complete with three sweet dishes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E06 — Gingerbread Worlds
The three remaining bakers face one challenge, but it's a massive one, constructing gingerbread worlds filled with all sorts of treats.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E01 — We're Nuts for the Holidays
Nutcrackers reveal assigned classic holiday nuts which then must be incorporated into a chocolate-nutty confection; the contestants highlight their favorite holiday memory in the form of a decorated pie.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E02 — Holiday Craftiness
The remaining nine bakers try to amp up the visual impact of holiday baked goods by creating festive candy cane and holiday wreath desserts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E03 — Stuffing Is the Best Part
The eight remaining bakers begin by making their best holiday whoopie pies; the bakers must create stuffed holiday cakes that reveal a surprise center when sliced open.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E04 — Thanksgiving's Just Around the Corner
Thanksgiving-inspired desserts; in the first round, canned cranberry sauce; in the main heat, the bakers must invent a dessert highlighting their assigned harvest ingredient.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E05 — Ginger and Spice and Everything Nice
The six remaining bakers revel in the warm flavor of ginger; for their first challenge they create mini desserts highlighting candied ginger, then create three different types of holiday cookies inspired by family traditions.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E06 — World Class Classics
The five remaining bakers reinvent two Hanukkah classics, rugelach and macaroons; a unique version of a holiday croquembouche.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E07 — Re-Gifting
The four remaining bakers must make a candy apple dessert inspired by a candy apple gift, then figure out how turn the contents of a traditional gift basket into a delicious dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E08 — Holiday Hoopla
The last three bakers must show off their decorating chops by baking and beautifully decorating a sugar cookie tree; in the final heat, the bakers need to transform their assigned holiday tradition into an intricately decorated cake.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E01 — Signs of the Season
Host Bobby Deen challenges the nine bakers to turn seasonal beverages like hot chocolate and apple cider into desserts; in the main heat, the chefs make decorative filled Bundt cake wreaths.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E02 — Grandma's Thanksgiving Favorites
Clash of the Grandmas star Norma Zager joins Bobby Deen to lend her expertise; for the pre-heat, the contestants must make two types of cookies; the bakers compete to create the best pie without the use of appliances.
